It added the second set of {{Color|FallenMission|Fallen}} skins and a few balancing changes. This update was also given the name ''Fallen Heroes Update (Part 2)''. This update consists of eight versions, the main v1.28.0 update (released 21 August 2024) and seven minor updates, the v1.28.1 (released 21 August 2024), v1.28.2 (released 22 August 2024), v1.28.3 (released 23 August 2024), v1.28.4 (released 23 August 2024), v1.28.5 (released 23 August 2024), v1.28.6 (released 23 August 2024) and v1.28 (released 27 August 2024). ==Additions== ===Maps===
